# Flowdot

> A tiny, zero-dependency framework and language (`.flow`) for animated architecture / data-flow
> diagrams on HTML canvas 2D. Structure and behaviour are declared in `.flow` text and compiled to an
> animated diagram — zero authored JavaScript.

If you are an AI agent authoring a diagram, read these two in order:

## Docs
- [AI-AUTHORING.md](docs/AI-AUTHORING.md): the mistake-free playbook — mental model, the closed verb set, every feature (incl. controls) with a minimal snippet, pitfalls, and a pre-flight checklist. Start here.
- [API.md](docs/API.md): the full grammar and surface — the three ways to build a diagram (imperative, IR builder, `.flow`), the per-kind attribute reference, and the action vocabulary.

## Optional
- [FLOW-FORMAT.md](docs/FLOW-FORMAT.md): the `.flow` grammar in detail.
- [HOWTO.md](docs/HOWTO.md): each feature with a minimal snippet and a live example.
- [ERRORS.md](docs/ERRORS.md): every located error message and what triggers it.
